$description: LIGHT design tokens. Regenerated from the Figma variables of the LIGHT Design System (file zK5Atg0210cM8IxDf8R8PL) on 2026-09-06 — Figma is the source of truth; edit there, then re-export here. W3C Design Tokens draft format ($value/$type). Names mirror the Figma collections: primitive = Primitives, semantic = Color, type = Type + text styles, space/radius/size/motion as named. Originally measured from ui/src/theme.css on 2026-09-05; see docs/design/system.md for the component inventory. `npm run tokens` regenerates ui/src/tokens.css and ui/src/tokens.ts from this file; `npm run typecheck` fails when they are stale or when theme.css carries a value Figma does not know.

primitive.$description: Raw palette. Nothing in the app should reference these directly — use semantic.

950.$description: previz ground; folds #101013 (2D canvas) and #0d0d10 (3D scene)

25.$description: a key’s face and a row at rest on a light ground

150.$description: fields, faders, pads, headers on a light ground

200.$description: a raised control on hover, light ground

250.$description: hairlines and seams on a light ground

350.$description: ≈5.2:1 on grey/50 — the floor for content on a light ground

700.$description: the cursor on a light ground; 5.4:1 on white

100.$description: a lamp at full — what is playing, and a lit key; 11:1 on --panel

600.$description: a lamp at full on a light ground, where text has to read it: 5:1 on white

500.$description: the lamp bar on a lit key, light ground — bright, never text; 3.1:1 on grey/25

450.$description: a lamp fading out on a light ground

500.$description: ride / soft override — resolves the undefined --amber; folds #ffb020 (.warnchip, meter override)

600.$description: warn on a light ground; 4.8:1 on grey/50

700.$description: hot on a light ground; 5.6:1 on white

50.$description: a danger key’s hover fill on a light ground

100.$description: a danger key’s armed fill on a light ground

scene.$description: canvas and WebGL palettes, kept apart so the console palette stays small

meter-idle.$description: a DMX channel sitting at zero in the output meter

meter-label.$description: a fixture's name written along its span in the output meter

alpha.$description: Translucent primitives for washes, soft fills, shadows and glows. Named by rounded opacity percent.

white-16.$description: the hover marker over the output meter

black-90.$description: text shadow on the FLASH mark

white-10.$description: a key’s top edge on hover

blind-6.$description: the blind tint: the editor ground off the rig, the grid on an editing page

accent-8.$description: alias of cyan-8: the learn / latch wash

black-20.$description: a menu’s shadow on a light ground

black-30.$description: a modal’s shadow on a light ground

tungsten-deep-25.$description: the playing pad’s halo on a light ground

semantic.$description: What the app actually references. One mode: dark. The app is a white-on-dark console for low-light rooms and does not ship a light theme.

panel.$description: chrome surfaces: top bar, bottom panel, panes, modal

seam.$description: the 1px gaps between shell regions — a hairline, not black (design 3.5)

blind.$description: the editor ground off the rig; the grid on an editing page

wash-learn.$description: the grid while learn or the latch is on

pad-empty.$description: an empty pad is a well: fill only, no border (Figma: 0 % alpha)

secondary.$description: ≈5.1:1 on panel — the floor for content

live.$description: the desk’s own light — the only thing that glows besides the look

default.$description: what is playing: pad halo, now-playing name, current song, column rule, fadebar, LIVE lamp

lamp.$description: the 5 px lamp on a pressed key — one family with what is playing

key.$description: a hardware key: flat face, a top edge, a bottom shade (design 2.1)

edge-hi-hover.$description: the top edge on hover — the only thing hover changes besides the text

fill-rest.$description: a master’s fill at rest — neutral, never accent

ok.$description: a healthy lamp is bright, not green; trouble is amber, loss is red

good.$description: alias of status/ok kept for the components that still read --good inline (LicencePanel, OutputView, PatchView, UpdatePanel); retire with lane 2 #11 / #14

nudge.$description: one amber: the nudge state is the warn colour

stub-fill.$description: tr.rowstub — fixture with a placeholder profile

dark-fill.$description: tr.rowdark — fixture whose profile is missing

danger.$description: soft-red controls: clear layer, delete, all stop, muted chip

blackout.$description: the one control allowed its own red

text-shadow.$description: text on top of a pad’s colour block

elevation.$description: Shadow colours, bound into the effect styles.

sans.$description: IBM Plex Sans, self-hosted under ui/public/fonts when the owner adds the files; the system stack until then

mono.$description: IBM Plex Mono — tabular figures and a slashed zero on any tablet; the CSS name stays --mono for the components that read it inline

solid.$description: the pad’s two-line name strip, glyph-only keys

style.$description: Twelve text styles (design 3.2) plus pad-name: family, weight and size are bound to Type variables in Figma; tracking and leading are literal on the style because Figma applies bound numbers to those two fields as pixels. Caps only on micro, label and key.

micro.$description: corner marks, kind glyph labels, lamp words, the fader label, chips

label.$description: section labels (DIALS, GROUPS), row labels (DIMMER), column heads

key.$description: hardware keys: ALL STOP, BLACKOUT, TAP, SYNC, FREEZE, the view keys, L1–L4

ui.$description: buttons that are not keys, chips, menus, library rows, table cells — sentence case

name.$description: pad, look, song and fixture names, now-playing — as typed, never forced to caps

value.$description: fader values, addresses, counts, times — tabular, slashed zero

readout.$description: BPM, MASTER on the remote, the network address

strip-vertical.$description: .librarystrip .label — written vertically; kept as it is

table-head.$description: table.tbl th; kept as it is

pad-name.$description: .cell .cellname — the pad’s name strip: two lines of 11 in a 22 px strip, sentence case as authored (design 2.3)

size.$description: Font sizes used by the styles; Figma Type:size/* (9_5 = 9.5).

15.$description: the + on an empty dial slot; the song × in touch mode

space.$description: core = 2/4/6/8/12/16/24; 3 and 5 are pixel-tuned exceptions inside the pad grid

11.$description: .seg button horizontal padding in touch mode

13.$description: .controlrow margin-top — the rule-off above the dial row

pad-w-min.$description: the pad floor: the narrowest that holds an 11 px two-line name

pad-w-max.$description: the pad ceiling in the minmax grid track

pad-h-pads.$description: a pad in the Pads view (58, size/pad-h, in Build’s context row); the dial row matches, being the APC’s fifth row

pad-name.$description: the select-without-firing strip: two lines of text/pad-name

layerhead-w.$description: layer head and dial head width — 120 × pad-h, sticky-left

layerhead-w-narrow.$description: the head when the grid area is under 1,200 px, so a panel narrows the head and not the pads

heldlist-w.$description: the list behind the held chip

min-grid-w.$description: head 120 + 8 × 96 + nine 3 px gaps + the 30 px add column

min-grid-w-narrow.$description: the same floor with the narrow head

touch-target.$description: the floor every target reaches in touch mode: `.app.touch`, automatic on a coarse pointer (`pointer: coarse`), forced on or off in Settings > Display. The Size collection's Touch mode carries the values (`modes` on each token); the Value mode is the laptop density. Review M14.

fader-min-w.$description: the floor a fader can be squashed to

min-grid-h.$description: the Pads view’s vertical need: heads 26 + song row 30 + 5 × 72 + groups 40 + 7 gaps × 3 + 20 wrapper padding

min-band.$description: the band’s floor before it folds

band-build.$description: the audition band Build opens with

blend-chip-w.$description: the layer head’s blend chip — “brightest” needs 80

rule.$description: every 2px accent line: the tab’s top, the pad’s fade bar, the selected-row marker

cornermark.$description: the corner mark: a flag, not a border

lamp.$description: the lamp primitive: the bar on a lit key, the node-health lamp, the beat LED

fader-max-w.$description: a fader never grows past this

value-w.$description: the value column beside a fader, outside the fill

toast-top.$description: the top-right notice stack starts below the strip and the status line (68) with a 12 gap

panic-w.$description: the panic pair’s own grid area: 92 + 96 + a 10 gap, right-anchored on every view

statusline.$description: the status line under the command strip

master-w-narrow.$description: MASTER once the strip has dropped it to the narrow width

guide-strip.$description: the setup guide docked as a strip

gridstrip.$description: Build’s one pad row: heads + pads (design #42)

songnow-max-w.$description: the song chip before its name gives way to an ellipsis

picker-max-h.$description: the set list before it scrolls

icon.$description: a glyph from the one drawn set (design 3.3)

icon-touch.$description: the same glyph where a fingertip has to find it

icon-stroke.$description: the one stroke weight every drawn glyph shares

glow-pad.$description: a playing pad’s glow, in the look’s first colour: --pad-glow is set inline from lookSwatch[0] and defaults to transparent — the one place saturated colour leaves the pad, so Figma holds it as a placeholder colour

press.$description: a pad or key brightens on press

fold.$description: a panel folds — height only, never a slide

hold.$description: the ring on hold-to-clear, hold-to-find, hold-to-unlock; touch.ts LONG_PRESS_MS reads this

hold-latch.$description: a FREEZE press shorter than this latches

pulse-blackout.$description: the strip’s only pulse: BLACKOUT armed

pulse-find.$description: the held chip and the remote’s LIVE lamp while a find is on — find overrides blackout

opacity.$description: Figma: Opacity (number variables). The only opacities a pad face may carry.

face-hover.$description: a pad face under the pointer

face-playing.$description: a pad face while the look plays, or while it is pressed

disabled.$description: a control the show cannot use right now

ratio.$description: Figma: Ratio (number variables). Fractions of a window or an area.

band-pads.$description: the band’s share of the window height when Pads opens

plan-w.$description: the plan column’s share of the Rig page
